summary: A 100-foot steel fire tower moved from near Isle, MN to Mille Lacs Kathio State Park in 1981, now a public climbable overlook.

access.note: Open to climb as a Minnesota state park attraction; on Minnesota DNR land.

visit.trail_note: Short walk to the tower within Mille Lacs Kathio State Park, atop one of the highest hills of the Mille Lacs Moraine.

events.note: Originally built and operated as a fire lookout tower near Isle, Minnesota; build year not found in available sources.
Moved from near Isle to Mille Lacs Kathio State Park, where it was re-erected on a hill of the Mille Lacs Moraine.

sources.title: Top Stops at Mille Lacs Kathio State Park

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build year, builder, or the tower's original agency/duty near Isle, or when it stopped serving as a working lookout before the 1981 move. The FFLA state list (cached) and Wikidata both just confirm name, location, county, and 'standing' status, with no narrative detail. Height (100 ft) and the 1981 move date are corroborated by multiple independent sources (Exploration Vacation, Mpls.St.Paul Magazine, and MN DNR), which is why confidence is medium rather than low despite the record itself being nearly empty. Fact-check 2026-10-04: the draft stated the tower is "steel" and has an "enclosed" platform, and gave the moraine/dam description in wording copied almost verbatim from the DNR/mspmag pages; none of the cited sources mention the tower's material or an enclosed platform, so those were removed, the moraine sentence was rewritten in original wording, and the Isle origin claim's footnote was corrected to the sources that actually say "near Isle" (Exploration Vacation and DNR, not mspmag).
